messages.subject: [OGRUG] Google Summer of Code
messages.body_plain:
R will be applying again this year to participate in the Google Summer of Code activity.
This program by Google pays students quite handsome stipends to work on open-source
projects from different organizations. This year's ideas list is at

http://rwiki.sciviews.org/doku.php?id=developers:projects:gsoc2011

If accepted, students may propose work plans i.e., revisions of the ideas, to the mentors.
Mentors then rank these work plan proposals and submit them to Google. R has had the
distinction of having all their approved students funded.

There is still time for developers/scientists to propose ideas or to offer to help as
mentors or backup mentors. (Don't forget to tell likely students about he program!). And
students are welcome to get in touch with mentors to find out more about the ideas listed.

For info, Claudia Beleites and I are co-admins for the R GSOC effort in 2011.

Best,

John Nash

messages.subject: [OGRUG] Permissions and Access access with R
messages.subject_clean: [OGRUG] Permissions and Access access with R
messages.body_plain:
Hello:

I've been trying to extract some data records from a security enabled Access database using R. Although I seem to have permissions to access the database, R does not appear to be able to read any records. Does anyone have a suggestion or possible solution. Here is the error message:

> source("C:\\stass\\Martell Data\\Dimport.r")
Loading required package: RODBC
> objects()
[1] "Biodata" "channel"
> Biodata
[1] "42000 -1907 [Microsoft][ODBC Microsoft Access Driver] Record(s) cannot be read; no read permission on 'agecomp'."
[2] "[RODBC] ERROR: Could not SQLExecDirect 'SELECT * FROM \"agecomp\"'"                                              
> 

Jake

Jake Schweigert,
Section Head, Conservation Biology
Fisheries and Oceans | Pêches et Océans
Marine Ecosystems and Aquaculture Division | Division des 
écosystèmes marins et de l'aquaculture
Pacific Biological Station | Station de recherché biologique du Pacifique

Nanaimo, BC   V9T 6N7 | Nanaimo (C.-B.)  V9T 6N7
Telephone | Téléphone   250-756-7203

messages.subject: [OGRUG] Toronto R User's Group Meeting Announcement
messages.subject_clean: [OGRUG] Toronto R User's Group Meeting Announcement
messages.body_plain:
Dear Ottawa R Users,

I'm glad to announce the next Toronto R user's group meeting on Friday,
March 25, 2011 3:00-5:00 pm. We have a very special speaker for this
event: John Fox will be presenting topics in Programming in R. John is
the Senator William McMaster Professor of Social Statistics in the
Sociology Department at McMaster University. He is an active contributor
to R and he is a member of the R Foundation. He is author of many
articles and books, including his most recent publication R Companion to
Applied Regression, Second Edition <http://tinyurl.com/carbook> . 

I'd like to especially thank Professor Murtaza Haider for providing a
fully equipped meeting room for this event in the Ted Rogers School of
Management at Ryerson University. The address is:

55 Dundas Street West
Lecture Hall, 9th Floor, Room 3-109.
Toronto, ON 

The building is connected to the Yonge Subway station. There will be
signs available on the 9th floor to guide the visitors to the lecture
hall. 

The capacity for the room is 40, so we'll have to prioritize in order of
sign-up for the meeting. 

Please RSVP to this meeting here:

http://www.meetup.com/Greater-Toronto-Area-GTA-R-Users-Group/events/1687
6298/http://www.meetup.com/Greater-Toronto-Area-GTA-R-Users-Group/events
/16876298/

I think this is a very special opportunity not to be missed. Hope to see
you there!

Regards, 
Leo.
